svg.text: • TB1 (user authentication): Auth.js credentials login, bcrypt cost 12, rate limits checked before any lookup,
HttpOnly JWT cookie with a random session id revoked on logout.
• TB2 (authorization): every data route checks Workspace.userId against the session user, then that the
conversation or file belongs to the workspace. Failures return 404, never 403.
• TB3 (service authentication): Next.js signs a 5-minute ES256 token per call; the backend holds only public
keys (JWKS) and fails closed (503) if they are missing.
• The backend uses only the token's workspace_id; request bodies are parsed only after authentication.
• Known limits: in-memory rate limits and replay cache (single instance), no HTTPS in the local demo, no
